about: Our own changes to the original's phone layout (below 768px wide), written by hand: the capture never writes this file, and nothing here changes wider screens. Blocks are named by their ids, under the page they're on. 'area' is the block's place on the phone grid ([first row, first column, row after its last, column after its last], numbered as the original numbers them); 'z' its layer; 'hide' hides it on phones; 'zoom' marks a picture of text that opens full size when tapped. Sections are named by their ids too, with the number of rows their phone grid has. Each says what it fixes. The rules every page follows are in site/phoneLayout.ts and site/styles/phone.css.
